verdict.rationale: Websets are built for operating across many items at once. A Webset takes a query and a target item count, checks every candidate against your criteria, and fills enrichment fields for each accepted item. Results arrive asynchronously via API or webhooks, the Contents API accepts multiple URLs per call, and the Agent API builds large lists and enriches entities. Community reports of items stuck on 'Verifying...' and low match accuracy point to quality and speed problems rather than a missing bulk capability. missing for 10: documented batch size limits or bulk mutation/management operations on existing items, and independent hands-on confirmation that large bulk runs complete reliably.
